scholarships.name: Mahatma Gandhi Scholarship Scheme (MGSS, Class 11 and 12)
scholarships.covers: NPR 24,000 per year (NPR 2,000/month) for two years across Class 11 and 12, paid directly into the student's bank account
scholarships.who: Regular Class 11 students in Nepal with at least 60% in SEE and annual family income below NPR 200,000
scholarships.how: Apply online directly on goischolarship.com.np during the October-November window; the Embassy rejects agent submissions

scholarships.name: Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme (GJSS, Bachelor in Nepal)
scholarships.covers: NPR 48,000/year for MBBS, BDS, BE, BTech, BArch and BAMS; NPR 36,000/year for other bachelor programmes in Nepal
scholarships.who: First-year bachelor students in recognised Nepali institutions with strong Class 12 marks and family income under NPR 200,000/year
scholarships.how: Apply online directly on goischolarship.com.np when the annual call opens in autumn

scholarships.name: TU IOE Constituent Regular Merit Quota
scholarships.covers: Heavily subsidised Regular tuition (around NPR 63,000 for 4 years vs NPR 5.46 lakh Full Fee) across 630 of the 2,040 constituent seats
scholarships.who: Top rankers in the IOE computer-based entrance exam (plus 10% women quota and inclusive reservation)
scholarships.how: Score high in the IOE entrance and list Regular seats first on the campus priority form at Pulchowk, Thapathali, Purwanchal, Paschimanchal or Chitwan

scholarships.name: Pokhara University Central Scholarship Quota
scholarships.covers: Full tuition waiver on 10 to 20% of seats across constituent and affiliated engineering, BBA, BHM, BPH, BPharm, BSc Nursing and MBA colleges
scholarships.who: Nepali citizens passing PU's central scholarship entrance, with 80% reserved for community/government school SEE graduates and 20% open to institutional schools
scholarships.how: Apply on the Pokhara University scholarship portal when the annual call opens

scholarships.name: Kathmandu University Merit, Need and Geomatics Scholarships
scholarships.by: Kathmandu University and Government of Nepal
scholarships.covers: Full or partial tuition waiver (1 scholarship seat per 24 paying students, plus Land Management Ministry scholarships in BE Geomatics)
scholarships.who: Admitted KU students with top entrance scores or verified financial need
scholarships.how: Apply at the time of KU admission through the respective school dean's office

scholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (France)
scholarships.by: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (Campus France)
scholarships.covers: Monthly allowance of EUR 1,181 to 1,200 (master) or EUR 2,000 (PhD), return international airfare and insurance
scholarships.who: Top international applicants nominated by a French university (priority in science, engineering, economics, management, law and political science)
scholarships.how: Apply early to a French university (October-November) and request nomination for Eiffel before the January deadline

scholarships.name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition paid to the Swedish university, SEK 12,000/month living stipend, travel grant and insurance
scholarships.who: Nepali graduates with demonstrated leadership and at least 3,000 hours of work experience
scholarships.how: Apply for a Swedish master programme on universityadmissions.se by mid-January, then submit the SI scholarship application in February

scholarships.name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships (Belgium)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition waiver, monthly allowance around EUR 1,150, return flights and insurance at KU Leuven, Ghent, Antwerp, Hasselt or VUB
scholarships.who: Graduates from eligible developing countries (including Nepal) applying to accredited English-taught development master programmes
scholarships.how: Apply through the participating Flemish university's programme page before the January-February scholarship deadline

scholarships.name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)
scholarships.by: Asian Development Bank and Government of Japan
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, monthly subsistence and housing allowance, book/research allowance, medical insurance and airfare
scholarships.who: Bachelor graduates from ADB member countries (including Nepal) under age 35 with at least two years of full-time work experience
scholarships.how: Apply for admission and the ADB-JSP sheet directly at a designated partner institution (such as AIT Thailand, University of Tokyo or NUS)

exams: IELTS or TOEFL for English courses
abroad.work: Part-time work allowed up to 964 hours per year; post-study job-search residence permit for master graduates
abroad.note: Public universities often waive differentiated fees down to EUR 178-254/year for strong applicants. Apply through the Etudes en France (Campus France) portal.

abroad.work: Students may work alongside studies; 12-month post-study permit to seek work
abroad.note: All university applications go through one central portal (universityadmissions.se) in October-January.

abroad.work: Part-time work up to 20 hours per week in term time; 12-month search year after graduation
abroad.note: Public research universities such as KU Leuven and Ghent offer high quality English-taught masters at lower tuition than the UK or US.

abroad.work: Part-time work up to 20 hours per week; PhD positions are salaried full-time employment with no tuition
abroad.note: Since 2023 most Norwegian public universities charge tuition to non-EU bachelor and master students, though PhD fellowships remain salaried.

abroad.work: Off-campus work is restricted on a student visa; campus assistantships are common
abroad.note: The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Mahidol and Chulalongkorn host many Nepali master and PhD scholars on ADB-JSP, Royal Thai and university fellowships.

abroad.work: Part-time work and internships allowed in free zones and with a student work permit
abroad.note: Verify whether the campus is accredited by the UAE Ministry of Education and whether degree transfer to a home campus is genuine before paying.
